example.en: Her face lit up with joy when she heard the news.
example.zh: 听到这个消息时，她脸上洋溢着喜悦。

senses.en: a person or thing that makes someone very happy
senses.zh: 令人高兴的人或事；快乐源泉

example.en: Her grandchildren are her greatest joy.
example.zh: 她的孙辈是她最大的快乐。

senses.en: a connection or relationship between two things or people

example.en: There is a strong link between exercise and good health.
example.zh: 运动与健康之间有很强的联系。

senses.en: to connect two or more things or people

example.en: The new road links the village to the town.
example.zh: 这条新路把村庄和城镇连接起来。

senses.en: a word or image on a computer screen that opens another page when clicked

example.en: Click the link to open the website.
One link in the chain was broken.
example.zh: 链条上的一个链环断了。

senses.en: a set of rules a computer follows to solve a problem
senses.zh: 计算机解决问题所遵循的一套规则

example.en: The search algorithm ranks pages by relevance.
example.zh: 该搜索算法按相关性对页面进行排名。

senses.en: a step-by-step method for solving a problem

example.en: She followed a simple algorithm to choose the best route.
example.zh: 她按照一个简单的算法来选择最佳路线。

senses.en: the quality of being hard to do or understand

example.en: The difficulty of the task surprised us.
example.zh: 这项任务的难度让我们吃惊。

senses.en: a problem or situation that makes something hard

example.en: We ran into a technical difficulty.
example.zh: 我们遇到了一个技术难题。

senses.en: a situation in which someone has problems or needs help

example.en: The family is in financial difficulty.
example.zh: 这个家庭陷入经济困难。

senses.en: used to show an exact place or position

example.en: She is waiting at the door.

senses.en: used to show an exact time
used to show a level, rate, or price
senses.zh: 以（表示水平、速度或价格）

example.en: We bought the tickets at a low price.
